subject: Everline leadership workshop — seating, content slots & preread timeline
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Marco DiStefano <marco@everline.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Everline leadership workshop — seating, content slots & preread timeline

Hi Marco — great to connect yesterday. Per our call, attaching a first-pass attendee list and a venue floorplan so the team can start mapping seats and breakout zones. Key asks from my side: 

1) Final headcount by EOD Monday (we have a working number but need firm)
2) Confirm preferred AV setup: single screen + confidence monitor, or dual screens + on-stage mic?
3) Any dietary constraints we should bake into catering?

Proposed content approach: short executive brief (20 min) -> two concurrent workshop tracks (40 min each) -> alignment plenary (30 min) -> leadership Q&A panel (25 min). I sketched presenter slots in the attached Presenter_Slot_Timeline.xlsx — we can swap as needed.

Timeline: we plan to lock the preread pack by Friday so we can circulate 5 business days before the event. Can you confirm whether Everline legal needs to review the preread? If so, please share the reviewer contact.

Attaching: Everline_Attendee_List.xlsx, GrandHarbor_Floorplan_v2.pdf, Presenter_Slot_Timeline.xlsx

Thanks — Connor
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Marco DiStefano <marco@everline.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Everline leadership workshop — seating, content slots & preread timeline

Connor — thanks for the clear plan and the docs. A few quick items: 

- Headcount: currently confirming with people managers; most likely 38 but could swing to 42. I will lock by Monday EOD.
- AV: dual screens on stage preferred; we have two senior execs joining remotely for the Q&A and want crisp feed. Stage mic + lapel for the panelists please.
- Diet: I'll send a combined list from HR, expect 3 vegetarian + 2 gluten-free.
- Legal review: yes, procurement team will run a light review of the preread. Looping procurement (procurement@everline.com) on this thread. They typically take 48 hours.

One more ask — can you propose a seating map that reserves front-center for our CEO and CTO, and a small satellite table for observers? Also, do you have a recommended morning arrival/check-in flow to keep the execs on schedule?

Best,
Marco
Head of People Ops, Everline

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Everline workshop — seating proposal + preread milestone (for ops)

Team — forwarding Marco's notes. Action items: 

- Lauren: can you produce a front-center seating map and a satellite observer table based on the attached floorplan? Need export (PDF) by Monday noon.
- Marissa: please owns preread pack consolidation. We should target 6 pages for the executive brief + appendix. Draft 1 due Wednesday. Loop in Legal if procurement asks.
- Neha: confirm AV vendor quote for dual screens + remote RTMP feed; include costs for lapel + stage mic + on-site AV tech for day. We want a fallback of encoder box in case the venue network is flaky.

I'll take the attendee gating and produce a named check-in roster for the front desk. Also thinking about an arrival cadence: 7:30 AM vendor load-in, 8:15 AM speaker mics/test, 8:45 AM VIP arrival/check-in, 9:00 AM start. Thoughts?

Connor

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Everline workshop — seating proposal + preread milestone (for ops)

Connor/Team — reviewed floorplan and sketched two seating options. Key notes in the attached PDF: 1) Option A (theater-forward) keeps CEO/CTO centered with two reserved front seats and a 6-person observer table stage-left; 2) Option B (u-shape) gives more table interaction but reduces AV sightlines slightly. I recommend Option A for exec Q&A clarity.

I updated the Presenter_Slot_Timeline.xlsx: swapped the order so the leadership panel follows the workshop tracks (gives them time to reference artifacts). Also added a 10-minute buffer between concurrent tracks and plenary to handle overruns. 

Attachment: Seating_Options_GrandHarbor.pdf, Presenter_Slot_Timeline_v2.xlsx

Lauren
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Marco DiStefano <marco@everline.com>, Procurement Everline <procurement@everline.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Grand Harbor Events <venue@grandharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Everline leadership workshop — seating, content slots & preread timeline

Marco / Procurement — thanks for the quick turn. We have locked Option A seating (front-center for CEO/CTO + stage-left observer table) and will provision dual screens + lapel + stage mic. Neha will share the AV quote this afternoon. 

Pre-read plan: Marissa will circulate Workshop_PreRead_Pack_v1.pdf by Wednesday morning for a 48-hour procurement/legal review window. If procurement needs edits after that review, please flag ASAP — our circulation deadline is Friday so we can get final PDFs to attendees by next Tuesday. 

Arrival/check-in flow (confirmed): 
- 7:30 AM: AV vendor load-in and AV tech check
- 8:00 AM: Materials drop at registration table (badges, preread printouts for execs)
- 8:30 AM: Speaker soundcheck and confidence monitor check
- 8:45 AM: VIP fast-track check-in (reserved desk near main entrance)
- 9:00 AM: Doors open for attendees; session starts at 9:15 AM

Attachments: Workshop_PreRead_Pack_v1.pdf, Everline_Attendee_List_Final.xlsx, GrandHarbor_Floorplan_Final.pdf

Connor
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
